dct_description_sm: Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
Contributors: Gavit, John E., 1817-1874; Gibson, Wm. T. (William T.); Seneca County Agricultural Society (N.Y.)
General-content county map showing towns (townships), military survey lot lines, lot numbers, rural buildings, and householders' names.
Includes Census of 1850 statistical table, "Village statistics" table, and marsh/swamp acreage table for Town of Tyre.
LC copy imperfect: Mounted on cloth backing, laminated, darkened, fold-lined, missing small edge sections.
Publication statement: Albany : Engraved & printed by John E. Gavit.; [New York State?] : [publisher not identified], 1850.
dct_title_s: Topographical map of Seneca County, N.Y.
